findings.reason: Step 2.1 proves only J=I_a-s is contained in I_b, then infers t∈J from t∈I_b; prove the translate y maximal by translating any proper extension back to x(·;a), yielding I_b=J.

Step 1.1's contradiction premise does not imply a hit of the fixed radius ρ+MT, and step 6.1 applies an open-set C¹ criterion to the nonopen slab [0,T]×B; establish fixed-ball trapping and a local extension across both time endpoints.

Step 1.1 uses δ-balls though separation gives only distance ≥δ, and M,L depend on an N-subdivision chosen from those bounds; at t₀=0, step 5.1 proves only positive times, so shrink the gap, bound on a fixed compact tube, and add a −F patch.

Fact F1 infers Eᵤ={0} from all eigenvalues having negative real part, but the cited dichotomy statement does not state the spectrum-to-subspace correspondence; derive it from the complexified eigenspaces before using the full stable estimate.

Fact F1 asserts a positive-real-part eigenvalue forces Eᵤ≠{0}, which is not in the dichotomy statement; show that a nonzero real or imaginary part of a complex eigenvector decays backward and use clause 4.

Clause 3 calls P a C¹ diffeomorphism of Σ=h⁻¹(0)∩W without establishing its embedded C¹ structure; use Dh(xᵢ)F(xᵢ)≠0 and the implicit function theorem to give section charts and verify the restrictions there.

Approved CM16 materials conflict: E12/notes require a finite transversal return, while the prose scaffold and statement promise a first return; the current hypotheses allow earlier Σ-hits, so the missing no-earlier-hit condition and its persistence need owner resolution.

Outside-batch clause (iii) repeats the first-return claim under the same transversality assumptions; owner review is needed for this physical public definition if the proposition's scope is corrected.

The limit is taken only over {t:(t,x)∈Ω}, which may be bounded and make the epsilon definition vacuous or nonunique; require a forward-unbounded lifetime, or existence for every t≥0, before assigning an exponent.
This outside-batch physical definition repeats the same limit convention; clarifying the mathematical definition requires owner-led review of this public definition and its consumer cone.
